description.value: The Old House Hotel & Spa is an all-suite hotel set along the Courtenay River Estuary in the Comox Valley, comprising two West Coast-inspired buildings named Maple and Cedar. It offers a full-service spa, outdoor heated pool and hot tub, gym, kitchenette-equipped suites, and a 24-hour refreshment centre. Centrally located a few blocks from downtown Courtenay, it is well-positioned for cyclists exploring Vancouver Island's east coast and the broader Comox Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms a real, operating all-suite hotel at 1730 Riverside Lane, Courtenay, BC. However, the OSM name ('Old House Village Hotel & Suites') differs from the website name ('Old House Hotel & Spa'), the OSM phone (+1-250-703-0202) differs from the website's prominent toll-free number (888-703-0202), and the OSM URL (oldhousevillage.com) differs from the canonical URL shown in the footer (www.oldhousehotel.com). No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all cycling criteria default to null.
